items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: he went with a guy named Erskine Tate at a theater called the Vendome in Chicago

ctx.x: Well, this is the first time I've ever heard it mentioned, anyone going, any jazz musicians going to play in China. I've heard of lots of European trips, but was there a jazz audience in China or --

Oh, sure, and they had a pianist that used to play with Erskine Tate at the Vendome Theater in Chicago and he -- Teddy Wetherford. That was his name. I just happened to think of it. You see, it come back as we keep talking.
